row.evidence: Creator's Directories help page says Azure, Okta and JumpCloud sync into Zoho Directory over SCIM and that the feature is available "only in the paid plans of Creator"; the plan comparison marks Active directory support on Standard, Professional and Enterprise.
row.notes: New row. SCIM is delivered through Zoho Directory Directory Stores (Okta, Entra ID, JumpCloud, or any SCIM client via a custom store) and synced users are then assigned to Creator; Creator pages put this on every paid plan, so the team plan (Standard, $8/user/mo annual) includes it. SAML SSO is an add-on on Standard and Professional and included on Enterprise ($25). Zoho Directory's own Free plan is capped at 10 users, and it is not documented whether Creator users count against that cap. Creator's REST API covers app data only; no user-management endpoints are documented.

scim.notes: SCIM lands in Zoho Directory (the org-wide identity layer every Zoho app uses) through a Directory Store; the "Sync endpoint" URL is generated per store and its pattern is not documented. Zoho's Okta guide pairs the SCIM app with a SAML app pointing at Zoho Directory Custom Authentication, but the Entra, JumpCloud and custom-store guides do not require SSO, so sso_required is left null.

auth.token_source: Zoho Directory Admin Panel > User Management > Directory Stores > Add Directory > (Okta / Entra ID / JumpCloud / Create Custom Store) > API INTEGRATION: Sync endpoint and SCIM token
auth.notes: Okta sends the token as an HTTP Header (Authorization). The Microsoft Entra gallery app "Zoho One" uses OAuth (Code Auth Grant) instead of a static token.

operations.notes: Okta can Push New Users and Push Profile Updates; user status changes are synced when Status Sync is enabled. Okta custom app integrations cannot Push Groups; JumpCloud syncs users through selected user groups. Update method (PUT vs PATCH) not documented.

deprovision.notes: Status changes in the IdP deactivate the Zoho Directory user when Status Sync is on. Deactivation releases a Zoho Directory licence; whether it frees the app seat is not documented. Creator says deactivation and deletion sync both ways between Creator and Zoho Directory.

filtering.notes: From Microsoft's Zoho One provisioning tutorial (userName marked as supported for filtering).

custom.how: Directory Store field mapping: profile field, hard-coded value, expression, custom attribute or JSON path mapped onto Zoho Directory fields (custom fields)

attributes.notes: Core and group attribute lists come from Microsoft's Zoho One provisioning tutorial (gallery app); Zoho Directory's own guides only describe field mapping in the admin panel.

roles.how: Zoho Directory conditional assignment assigns apps (and app roles, e.g. Zoho Desk roles/departments, Zoho CRM admin) based on group membership or designation; not a SCIM roles attribute

limitations.text: Okta custom app integrations cannot Push Groups or Import Groups.
JumpCloud syncs only groups of users, not individual users.
Entra provisioning runs on a 40-minute cycle (or on-demand Provision).
Zoho Directory Free plan allows only up to 10 users; paid Directory licences are $2 (Standard) or $7 (Professional) per user. How users of paid Zoho apps count against this is not documented.
Users synced into Zoho Directory must still be assigned to the Creator application (manually or by conditional assignment), up to the Creator plan's user limit.

user_api.notes: Creator API v2.1 covers Data, Publish, File, Meta, Bulk and Custom APIs; no user or role management endpoints are documented. Users are managed in Zoho Directory.

okta.notes: No product-specific OIN app with provisioning; Zoho's guide uses a custom Okta SAML app with SCIM provisioning pointed at Zoho Directory.

entra.notes: Gallery app is "Zoho One" (also a separate "Zoho" SSO app). Microsoft says to contact Zoho One support to enable provisioning. Zoho Directory also documents Entra ID SCIM provisioning via a Directory Store (sync endpoint + SCIM token).

jumpcloud.notes: Zoho's guide uses a JumpCloud Custom Application with Identity Management (SCIM base URL + token); no JumpCloud catalogue page was checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Zoho Directory Sync tool for on-prem Active Directory and OpenLDAP; Zoho Directory API-based imports from Okta/Entra/JumpCloud
